Class Lobby

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.server.Lobby
public class Lobby extends Object
Manages the pre-game phases, matchmaking, and lifecycle of a game session.

The Lobby class handles player registrations, unique nicknames and colors validation, game persistence recovery, network health checks, and match initialization or termination.

    • Lobby

      public Lobby()
      Constructs a default Lobby initializing a new PersistenceManager.

    • Lobby

      public Lobby(PersistenceManager persistenceManager)
      Constructs a Lobby with a specific PersistenceManager. If a saved game state exists, it automatically recovers and loads the previous game configuration.
      Parameters:
      persistenceManager - the persistence manager used to handle game saves

  • Method Details

    • addPlayer

      public void addPlayer(String nickname, Color color, GameObserver observer) throws Exception
      Handles player login requests. Adds a player to the lobby, registers their unique criteria, triggers database synchronization, and handles host setup or game initialization conditions.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the unique name chosen by the player
      color - the chosen color for the player's pieces
      observer - the remote observer for client-side view updates
      Throws:
      Exception - if the lobby is full, the host hasn't set the size yet, or if the nickname/color is already taken.

    • setTargetPlayers

      public void setTargetPlayers(int num) throws Exception
      Sets the expected number of players for the upcoming match. Called by the host client.
      Parameters:
      num - the desired number of players
      Throws:
      Exception - if the number of players is outside the bounds of MIN_PLAYERS and MAX_PLAYERS

    • handleDisconnection

      public void handleDisconnection(String nickname)
      Handles the intentional or accidental disconnection of a specific player. Safely unregisters client references before terminating the game.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of the player who disconnected

    • startNetworkHealthCheck

      public void startNetworkHealthCheck()
      Starts the periodic network health check routine. Runs a heartbeat ping task at fixed intervals to verify connected clients.
